headline: Brazilian President Lula Negotiates Fiscal Adjustment Amid Market Pressure
summary: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is conducting talks regarding fiscal adjustment measures and political support amid persistent pressure from financial markets.
why: Fiscal reform in Brazil is closely monitored by foreign and local investors for its impact on public debt sustainability and inflation expectations.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Fiscal policy adjustments influence investor sentiment toward Brazilian sovereign debt and assets.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Uncertainty surrounding Brazilian fiscal policy reforms led investors to demand higher risk premiums.
